title: Project MCP requirements
description: Consumer-owned .agents/mcp-requirements.json: a versioned declaration of the MCP services a project's workflows need. The manifest carries identities and references only — credential values, OAuth state, absolute machine paths and observed connection status never appear in it; additionalProperties is false throughout so value-bearing fields cannot hide, and reference fields reject absolute paths, command lines and parameterized URLs. scripts/mcp_requirements.ts implements these checks in plain TypeScript; guidance path resolution and identity uniqueness are supplemental repo-dependent checks the schema cannot express.

version.description: Manifest contract version; unsupported versions produce an actionable diagnostic.

id.description: Stable service identity, unique within the manifest and distinct from any client registration name.

purpose.description: What the service is for in this project.

required.description: Whether workflows this service applies to are blocked when it is unavailable; optional services never block.

workflows.description: Workflow names the requirement applies to; ["*"] means project-wide applicability.

guidance.description: Repo-relative paths to existing project documentation covering usage and account/project constraints — references, not copies; every path must resolve (repo-dependent, checked by the Python validator).

credential_refs.description: Environment-variable names the service needs beyond any auth credential_ref — names only, never values.

connection.description: Exactly one branch applies: remote (https endpoint or machine-local reference, plus optional auth) or stdio (a command reference). Fields are constrained per branch; additionalProperties is false within each.

oneOf.description: remote: exactly one of url or local_config_ref, plus optional auth. command_ref does not apply.
stdio: command_ref (required) plus optional local_config_ref; url and auth do not apply.

url.description: Portable https endpoint: dot-separated ASCII hostname (letters, digits, hyphens, underscores) with an optional numeric port and optional path — no userinfo, query string or fragment. Bracketed, internationalized or parameterized endpoints belong to the machine-local details a local_config_ref points at; this mirrors the exact grammar scripts/mcp_requirements.ts enforces.

localConfigRef.description: Free-form pointer to separately configured machine-local connection details — descriptive and machine-independent, never an absolute or machine-specific path; not validated as a repo path.

commandRef.description: Name of an environment variable or machine-local setting holding the executable command — never the command, its path or a command line.

oneOf.description: Interactive OAuth flow; credential_ref does not apply.
Static credential: the environment-variable NAME holding it — the value stays outside the manifest.

description.description: The bounded read-only check that would verify access.

read_only.description: Must be literally true; verification never writes.
